story.what_it_does: HCLTech is an IT services company that also sells software (HCLSoftware). FY26 revenue was ₹130,144 crore, up 11.2%, with the top twenty clients making up 28.5% of revenue. It is pushing into AI, with Advanced AI revenue of $219 million in the Sep-26 quarter.
story.plans: Management guides FY27 to 2.5% to 4.0% constant-currency revenue growth and an EBIT margin of 17.5% to 18.5%. It plans to grow AI-native services by 25% and to build an AI datacenter (initial ₹3,500 crore, 50 MW long term). The board has also committed to return at least 75% of net income to shareholders.
story.moat: The notes show a large and stable client base, with the top 5 clients at just 11.4% of revenue, and attrition of about 12.8%. Remaining performance obligations were ₹156,372 crore, and ROIC was 39.4% in the LTM to Dec-25. The notes do not describe any specific competitive advantage beyond these figures.

scenarios.story: Strong bookings ($3.3 billion in Q2 FY27, up 27% YoY) and a mega deal that starts contributing revenue next year could lift growth toward the top of guidance. Margins recovered to 18.2% as restructuring costs faded.
signals_to_watch: Services mega deal revenue starting to contribute in Q1 of next year
New deal bookings staying near the $3.3 billion level

scenarios.story: Growth stays in the guided 2.5% to 4.0% range, with margins inside 17.5% to 18.5%. Cautious management, a fluid demand environment and AI-related pricing deflation keep the outlook steady rather than improving.
signals_to_watch: Constant-currency revenue growth staying around 2.6% YoY
EBIT margin staying within the 17.5% to 18.5% guidance band

scenarios.story: Discretionary spending cuts at two US telecom clients and a manufacturing client ramp-down continue, and software keeps shrinking. AI deflation could also weigh on traditional work.
signals_to_watch: HCLSoftware revenue, which fell 11.2% YoY in Q2 FY27
Top 5, 10 and 20 client buckets still not growing
